pr.body:
This continues the original manuscript Theorem 1.1 / Corollary 1.2 proof at manuscript ba6ec11d800eccc54406490631895e174de85766. It proves actual prime-box test-function limits, uniform Euler normalization, exact first-exit selection and tuple dictionaries, signed difference multiplicity, and finite Fourier and smooth-frequency estimates for the original small core. Original selectors, complex coefficients, signed frequencies, outside moments, constants and quantifier order are retained.

The latest components prove an exact divisor-and-frequency Cauchy bound for the squared smooth core, genuine uniformly weighted ordinary derivatives for the slow reciprocal-phase Fourier profile, and an asymptotically negligible seventh-row error budget for the actual unit and original-P-at-most-N^(1/5) prime/semiprime branches. The latter retains coefficient 2 and repeated ordered prime factors. Each passes strict compilation, original stock replay, and complete serialized/generated declaration, type, safety and transitive-axiom checks at the fixed toolchain and dependency pins. The archived checkpoint covers 166 modules and 3,889 declarations; explicit source/archive/index/commit byte audits passed. Archived failed attempts are retained.

This is a component checkpoint. The retained nonzero spectral estimate, joint Mellin separation and its final squared cost budget, original same-policy sharp upper bound K, remaining large-P seventh-row main mean, complete selected Chen lower ledger C, and unconditional hLower/hUpper remain open. The joint log-variable estimate is an unaccepted candidate whose first compile diagnostics are being repaired. No aggregate root build, complete imported-closure replay, or unconditional 1+1.75 proof is claimed. CI and automation controls are unchanged.
pr.title: Prove exact sieve inputs and smooth reciprocal-phase estimates
